thread.title: Apple earnings will be all about the forecast: Live blog - MarketWatch

author: Jeremy C. Owens and Emily Bary
title: Apple earnings will be all about the forecast: Live blog - MarketWatch
text:
After a bruising stretch for some of the behemoths in the technology and internet-related world, can the granddaddy of them all—Apple Inc.—provide a modicum of comfort to an anxious market?
That’s the question Wall Street will find out—and soon. The iPhone maker will deliver fiscal third-quarter earnings after the close of Tuesday’s regular trade.
In the broadest strokes, investors want a measure of succor amid a period that has been marked by tariff battles between the U.S. and its international trade partners across the globe and the impact of those spats, a rising U.S. dollar. Apple AAPL, +0.43% watchers also will watch the outlook for some of the tech maker’s more popular gadgets and white-hot focus will be on Apple’s forecast for the September period . Investors also will parse management’s commentary for hints of what’s to come in the next iPhone cycle.
On top of that, revenue from services and China sales , as well as iPhone average selling prices, will garner attention and help gauge the strength of the largest publicly traded company on the planet.
MarketWatch tech editor Jeremy C. Owens ( @jowens510 ) and reporter Emily Bary ( @emilybary ) will live-blog the earnings report’s release, which is expected to hit at 4:30 p.m. Eastern time. They’ll also cover the company’s conference call, set to begin at 5 p.m.
